name: BDP bounded nested GraphQL (synthetic template, not UAT verified)

parameters.content: Synthetic template, NOT live UAT evidence. Bind your BDP Community OAuth2 API credential and replace the synthetic building UUID. To select BuildingIdentity, use that Operation Name and only its buildingId variable. No history or snapshot/completeness guarantee.
